--- **Step 2 – Basic test ideas (one per method)** *Constructors* – verify size after creation. *clone()* – cloned list contains deep‑cloned elements (modifying original does not affect clone). *attr(String)* – returns first matching attribute, empty string when none. *hasAttr(String)* – true/false depending on presence. *eachAttr(String)* – list contains values only for elements that have the attribute. *attr(String,String)* – sets attribute on all elements; verify with `attr(key)`. *removeAttr(String)* – attribute removed from all; verify with `hasAttr`. *addClass/removeClass/toggleClass/hasClass* – manipulate class attribute and verify. *val()* – returns value of first form element; empty when list empty. *val(String)* – sets value on all form elements; verify with `val()`. *text()* – concatenates texts with spaces. *hasText()* – true when any element has non‑blank text. *eachText()* – list of texts for elements that have text. *html()* – concatenates inner HTML separated by newline. *outerHtml()* – concatenates outer HTML separated by newline. *toString()* – same as `outerHtml()`. *tagName(String)* – changes tag name of each element. *html(String)* – replaces inner HTML of each element. *prepend/append* – add HTML before/after existing inner HTML. *before/after* – insert HTML before/after the element in the DOM. *wrap(String)* – wrap each element; throws `IllegalArgumentException` for empty string. *unwrap()* – removes element but keeps children. *empty()* – clears children of each element. *remove()* – removes each element from the DOM. *select(String)* – returns filtered Elements using a CSS query. *not(String)* – returns Elements that do **not** match the query. *eq(int)* – returns a single‑element list or empty when index out of bounds. *is(String)* – true when any element matches the selector. *next/next(String)/nextAll/nextAll(String)* – sibling navigation. *prev/prev(String)/prevAll/prevAll(String)* – previous‑sibling navigation. *parents()* – returns the full ancestor chain (no duplicates). *first()/last()* – return first / last element or null on empty list. *traverse(NodeVisitor)* – visitor is called for each node (test with a counter). *filter(NodeFilter)* – filter is applied (test with a counter). *forms()* – returns only `FormElement` instances. --- **Step 3 – Edge‑case & exception
